description: This file defines a React functional component named DeviceTable that renders a table of device information with functionalities like sorting and searching. It manages local state for search, sorting options, and debounces user input for searching. It relies on external components like StatusBadge and types, and handles user actions such as view, edit, delete, and ping for individual devices.

methods.name: DeviceTable
methods.description: React functional component rendering a searchable, sortable device table with action buttons.
